notes.title: Final Release before the ashes!
notes.content:
Hi all,

Its been a while since I updated the game and due to a number of circumstances I could not work on it as much as I wanted to. However, I did spend some time looking at and experimenting with a bunch of the possible features I mentioned in previous news posts.

The final update will implement the free hit mechanism, which is basically a giant floating target you have to try to hit. Hit it, and your runs are free for that delivery :)

After that I will tweak and adjust minor bugs or playability issues. The games planned final release is sometime just before the ashes start in late November.

The features at final release time will be:

- Single or local multiplayer modes
- 3 types of matches - 5, 10 or 20 over match.
- 3 difficulty levels.
- HTC Vive/Oculus compatible.
- Adjustable batting line and length.
- Batting sweet spot.
- AI fielders that adjust to your big shots.
- Batters get weaker further down the order.
- Adjustable line, length and speed for the bowler player in local multiplayer.
- Adjustable fielders in local multiplayer
- Crowd noise and reactions to shots, wickets and other moments. 
- Scoreboards both in game and for the desktop with detailed batter information.
- Multiple views for Batter and bowler.
- Action replays
- Free hit feature - hit the giant target.

Cheers

notes.title: June updates coming soon
notes.content:
Hi all, 

Thanks for any interest in this game.

Included are a couple of the latest screenshots in development

A few significant changes to the game in the next update (mid to late June) - 

* a replay is shown on the big screen for the VR player and on the desktop for the non VR player.
* The replay is a close up shot of the batter striking the ball, and it then switches to the tv camera view thats currently shown on the desktop when bowling.
* The batter now has control to proceed after each delivery (and adjust their base batting position if required). During this time is when you see the replay.

Cheers

notes.title: Batting position change and other future updates
notes.content:
Hi all, 

I have made a change to the batting setup. Between each over you can chage the batting base position. 

This is something for the standing experience version.
For room scale you likely wont need to adjust it.

My next 2 focus areas are

* online multiplayer.
* a replay system to see your shot.

Cheers

notes.title: Game updates
notes.content:
Hi all,

I have added some fixes to the game.

* It is easy to smack a six most of the time, even on the hard level. To address this I have added a change to the cricket bat. It now has the concept of a sweet spot. You will get haptic feedback from the controller. Now you will need to time your shots better.

* In easy mode, the fielders are slightly faster.

* AI smarter - The fielders have stopped being complete peanuts. They will adjust their positions if you hit a 4 or 6.

* As you go down the order the batters get worse. Your opener can hit the ball well, your number 6 not as well.

* Generally Improved graphics. You should have a smoother experience now.

Any issues please let me know asap.
Cheers

notes.title: Released
notes.content:
Alpha is away.

Features to come:

* power ups (think rings in the sky) to aim for to get a bonus hit.
* better fielding AI
* batting order weakens as you go down the list (so you openers can smash it, while the tailenders are lame ducks)

Please report any bugs or problems to the discussion board and I will view them and respond as soon as I can.

I welcome any constructive feedback on how I can make the game better.

Thanks for waiting on the release.

notes.title: Release this week
notes.content:
Game to be released this week!

Features:

Single and Multiplayer mode, with scoreboards
No more daytime, all games at night
Improved graphics
Randomised player names
Vastly improved sound, music
Second player can adjust bowling parameters and fielder positions
Improved AI
Steam achievements and Global leaderboards

You can actually play a single game, end to end! No more gimmicky hit ball simulations in VR. Now you have a reason to drink beer and play VR. 

It is an Alpha release. I will be keeping a close eye on all issues and anything game breaking will be addressed either immediately or as soon as possible.

Cheers

* much improved scoreboard visuals
* improved local multiplayer bowler feedback
* career stats in all difficulty modes
* many achievements and leaderboards
* improved gameplay and graphics
